**[Get WhisperShortcut on the Mac App Store](https://whispershortcut.com/go/appstore?src=github-release)** — automatic updates, one-time purchase.

## Read Aloud
- **More natural pauses.** Long texts are read in pieces, and a piece used to end at whatever word fit, often in the middle of a sentence, so the voice stressed that word as if the sentence were over. Pieces now end at the end of a sentence, or, for very long sentences, at a colon, semicolon, dash or comma. Abbreviations like "z. B." or "Dr." and dates like "3. Oktober" are no longer mistaken for sentence ends.

## Models
- **Claude Haiku 5.5** replaces Haiku 4.5 (faster and cheaper, 1M context).
- **Nano Banana 2.1** replaces Gemini 3.1 Flash Image for image generation (about half the price per image).
- A model you had selected moves to its replacement automatically.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.37...v8.38
